biography: Rasmus, hailing from Vihti Golf Club, has inscribed a unique, albeit concise, chapter in the narrative of the Hector Trophée, having made a solitary appearance in this distinguished pair competition. His participation, though limited to a single edition, signifies his engagement with the tournament's challenging format.

During his single competitive engagement, Rasmus confronted the demands of both the individual and pair formats with diligent effort. However, the ultimate accolades, specifically the coveted Hector Trophée for the winning pair or the individual Victor Trophy, remained beyond his reach during this sole participation.

Following this singular experience, Rasmus has largely receded from active contention within the Hector events, signaling a deliberate transition away from the tournament's regular circuit. This current posture is further affirmed by his absence from the roster for the forthcoming Hector Trophée 2026, marking a quiet close to his active pursuit of this particular championship.
